title: The nineteenth edition of Africa International News Magazine offers a comprehensive look at various pressing issues affecting the continent. This edition focuses on AFRICOM, exploring its implications and potential benefits, as well as the hidden agendas behind the US military presence in Africa. Additionally, it covers the ongoing political crisis in Kenya following the elections and provides insights into the international political landscape, particularly the competition between Hillary Clinton and Barack Obama for the Democratic nomination. A new column on human rights examines Nigeria's record and discusses calls for the establishment of a constitutional court. This edition promises to engage readers with its in-depth analysis and diverse topics.
